data.text: Plan: rebuild/update the PCB from the clean schematic, place all footprints within the 30 × 20 mm maximum with J1 at an edge, decouplers beside U1 supply pins, and AE1 plus its keepout at the antenna edge; route every net, document unavoidable first-draft compromises in LAYOUT.md, then verify DRC, ERC, legibility, and documentation drift. Risks: 2-layer 50 Ω RF geometry depends on the unconfirmed 1 oz fabricator stackup; antenna keepout and rotated footprint extents must remain inside the board constraints; no unrequested protection parts will be invented because SPEC.md explicitly excludes connector ESD protection.

args.why: Create the required first-draft physical implementation from the clean schematic, including the previously missing RF balun path, rule-driven placement, antenna keepout, complete routing, and honest draft-quality documentation while preserving the documented electrical, mechanical, and power constraints.
args.what_changes:
- Rebuild or update the PCB from the current schematic so every schematic footprint, including B1, C11, and C12, is present.
- Place J1 at a board edge, U1 support and decoupling parts at their relevant pins, and AE1 at an edge with the vendor-style antenna keepout honored.
- Keep all rotated footprint extents inside the maximum 30 mm × 20 mm outline and retain the two-layer 1.6 mm FR-4 stackup.
- Route every electrical net, including the differential RF path and 50-ohm-designated antenna feed, to zero unconnected items.
- Add docs/LAYOUT.md with an exact ## Draft quality section identifying acceptable first-draft work and RF/mechanical details requiring human or specialist-tool refinement.
- Record placement/routing decisions and append the run to the design changelog.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Inspect the existing board and schematic-derived footprint/net inventory.
- [ ] Synchronize all schematic footprints and nets into the PCB without changing refdes or net names.
- [ ] Define or retain a compliant board outline and place every footprint using rule-driven coordinates.
- [ ] Enforce antenna copper/component keepout and account for rotated footprint dimensions.
- [ ] Route all electrical nets on two layers.
- [ ] Run DRC, fix every unconnected item and blocking violation, and rerun to clean.
- [ ] Write docs/LAYOUT.md including ## Draft quality and update decisions/changelog.
- [ ] Run ERC, schematic legibility, documentation drift, and final verification.

data.name: propose_change

args.why: Create the required first-draft physical implementation from the clean schematic, including the previously missing RF balun path, rule-driven placement, antenna keepout, complete routing, and honest draft-quality documentation while preserving the documented electrical, mechanical, and power constraints.
args.what_changes:
- Rebuild or update the PCB from the current schematic so every schematic footprint, including B1, C11, and C12, is present.
- Place J1 at a board edge, U1 support and decoupling parts at their relevant pins, and AE1 at an edge with the vendor-style antenna keepout honored.
- Keep all rotated footprint extents inside the maximum 30 mm × 20 mm outline and retain the two-layer 1.6 mm FR-4 stackup.
- Route every electrical net, including the differential RF path and 50-ohm-designated antenna feed, to zero unconnected items.
- Add docs/LAYOUT.md with an exact ## Draft quality section identifying acceptable first-draft work and RF/mechanical details requiring human or specialist-tool refinement.
- Record placement/routing decisions and append the run to the design changelog.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Inspect the existing board and schematic-derived footprint/net inventory.
- [ ] Synchronize all schematic footprints and nets into the PCB without changing refdes or net names.
- [ ] Define or retain a compliant board outline and place every footprint using rule-driven coordinates.
- [ ] Enforce antenna copper/component keepout and account for rotated footprint dimensions.
- [ ] Route all electrical nets on two layers.
- [ ] Run DRC, fix every unconnected item and blocking violation, and rerun to clean.
- [ ] Write docs/LAYOUT.md including ## Draft quality and update decisions/changelog.
- [ ] Run ERC, schematic legibility, documentation drift, and final verification.
